title: Places to Stay
heading: One more day? Make a night of it.
intro: Just when you are getting into the swing of it, somebody says it is time to go home. How about staying a little longer? These UK hotel and accommodation guides help you choose a base for a seaside break, a town visit or a weekend with a big attraction in the middle. Browse places to stay in Blackpool and beyond, have a look at the food and days-out guides nearby, then check the room and dates that suit you. A good base leaves more time for the evening wander, the meal and tomorrow's discoveries.
